name: Space Commerce Activity Advisory Committee Act
status: Passed Senate; Held at the Desk in the House
effect: This bill requires the Office of Space Commerce to establish a Commercial Space Activity Advisory Committee to provide information and recommendations on nongovernmental space activities and promoting a robust and innovative commercial space sector.
alignment_notes: Aligns with Pillar 1 because it would have the Office of Space Commerce set up a 15-member Commercial Space Activity Advisory Committee drawn from industry, matching the report’s push to build industry best practices into US rules. Does not address pillar 2 or pillar 3.
sponsors: Sen. Ted Cruz [R-TX], Sen. Gary Peters [D-MI]
